notes.title: Available Now
notes.content:
Finally, "Almost Home Now" is free for all to play on Steam.  Thank you all who supported me on itch.io and wishlisted!

Feel free to start a discussion thread or find me on Steam if you have any problems.

notes.title: Expected Launch Delay
notes.content:
Greetings, all.


I'm sorry to announce that the launch of "Almost Home Now" will be delay for about a week.
Due to releasing a game on Steam for the first time, there are back-end things I haven't taken care of.
Therefore, the game cannot be released just yet.

I'm currently working on my second game and I'm trying to have it ready before this Friday.
My second game will be available on itch.io.  You can find all of my stuff there, including this title.

Once again, I'm sorry for having to delay the launch.
Though I hope I can make up for it with the launch of my new title.

Be sure to check [url=https://timeberwell.itch.io/]my itch.io page[/url] on Friday.
https://timeberwell.itch.io/

Thank you for understanding.


Regards,
Timberwell
